experiment_data.hypothesis: G-MFRM joint calibration on real Arena-Hard data (9 judges × 8 target models × 316 items) produces model ability estimates (θ) with higher agreement to Chatbot Arena human rankings (Kendall-τ) than raw averages, MFRM-only, and sequential pipelines, while simultaneously recovering interpretable per-model contamination susceptibility (c_n) and per-judge severity (d_j) profiles.
